ideas.pitch: An AI-powered municipal asset monitoring and automated grievance routing platform using aerial imagery and computer vision.
ideas.title: IndoreCivicSense AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite or drone imagery to real-world regional municipal compliance and infrastructure monitoring, which appeals directly to government-affiliated judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time predictive inventory forecasting and demand-matching tool for regional medical supplies and blood banks in Madhya Pradesh.
ideas.title: MedLogistics AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced time-series modeling and rigorous probabilistic backtesting similar to the Apart Research winning project, proving technical execution beyond a simple wrapper.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first, vernacular multi-agent crop disease advisory and marketplace price prediction system for local farmers.
ideas.title: AgriSutra
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent orchestration via LangGraph for localized agricultural support, echoing the winning architecture of the GreenNovation Hackathon project.

ideas.pitch: An adaptive, resume-to-upskilling pathway generator that maps local college curricula directly against emerging regional industrial job requirements.
ideas.title: SkillForge AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on employability and educational transformation, which aligns tightly with priorities typical of technical university organizers like SGSITS.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal video intelligence platform that indexes and queries unstructured CCTV or lecture footage locally without sending data to third-party clouds.
ideas.title: VidTrace AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the winning architecture of LibrAI, providing instant searchability and high utility for institutional media archives.
